name: hazenow-worker
description: HazeNow data server as a free Cloudflare Worker: cron-polled, budgeted upstreams stored in D1, the same HTTP API as services/proxy, and hourly community-sensor logging.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply hazenow-data --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.budget: bun -e 'import {simulateDay} from "./src/budget.ts"; await Bun.write("src/budget-data.json", JSON.stringify(simulateDay(), null, 2) + "\n")'
